context: A doctor walks an elderly patient through diagnostic findings
purpose: Teach: 肉体/体質/視覚/恐ろしい/強烈/蓄積/高等/必然

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 後藤さん、検査結果を見ますと、長年の肉体労働の影響が出ているようですね。
lines.en: Mr. Goto, looking at the test results, the effects of years of physical labor seem to be showing.
lines.style: Calm professional tone with measured pacing throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: やっぱりか…若い頃から無理ばっかりしてきたからのう。
lines.en: I knew it... I've been pushing myself too hard since I was young.
lines.style: Gravelly elderly male voice with resigned sigh

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: もともとアレルギー体質ということもあり、関節への蓄積疲労がかなり進んでおります。
lines.en: Combined with your allergic constitution, the accumulated fatigue in your joints has progressed considerably.
lines.style: Gentle but clinical delivery with careful enunciation

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 蓄積っちゅうのは、もう治らんもんなんかね、先生?
lines.en: This accumulated damage, can it not be healed anymore, doctor?
lines.style: Worried elderly tone with slight tremor in voice

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それから、視覚の検査でも気になる点がありまして、強烈な光に対する反応が鈍くなっています。
lines.en: Also, in the vision tests there are concerning points, your response to intense light has become dull.
lines.style: Serious tone shifting to deliver important news

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: そりゃ恐ろしい話じゃのう…運転も控えた方がええんかな。
lines.en: That's a frightening thing to hear... should I refrain from driving too?
lines.style: Anxious elderly voice with rural inflection

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、年齢を考えますと必然的に判断力も落ちますから、ご家族と相談なさってください。
lines.en: Yes, considering your age your judgment will inevitably decline, so please consult with your family.
lines.style: Soft empathetic delivery with reassuring closure

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: わかった。高等な医学のことはようわからんが、先生の言う通りにするわ。
lines.en: Understood. I don't really get advanced medicine, but I'll do as you say, doctor.
lines.style: Slow accepting tone with humble grandfatherly warmth
